The '''2020 Copa Sudamericana final''' was the final match which decided the winner of the [[2020 Copa Sudamericana]], the 19th edition of the [[Copa Sudamericana]], [[South America]]'s secondary international club [[Association football|football]] tournament organized by [[CONMEBOL]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/docs2020/Manual-de-Clubes-Sudamericana-2020-es.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes / Reglamento CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2020|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=Spanish}}</ref>

The match was played on 23 January 2021 at the [[Estadio Mario Alberto Kempes]] in [[Córdoba, Argentina|Córdoba]],<ref name="venue">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/conmebol-designa-maracana-rio-y-mario-kempes-cordoba-sedes-de-las-finales-unicas-de-libertadores-y|title=El Maracaná (Río) y el Mario Kempes (Córdoba) sedes de las Finales Únicas de Libertadores y Sudamericana 2020|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=17 October 2019|language=es}}</ref> Argentina, between [[Argentine Football Association|Argentine]] teams [[Club Atlético Lanús|Lanús]] and [[Defensa y Justicia]]. It was held [[Behind closed doors (sport)|behind closed doors]] due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]].<ref name="BCD"/>

The final was originally scheduled to be played on 7 November 2020.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2020_aprobado_consejo_13_06_2019.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2020: CONMEBOL Libertadores - CONMEBOL Sudamericana - RECOPA|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es}}</ref> However, as the tournament had been interrupted since March 2020 due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], CONMEBOL announced on 10 July 2020 that it would be rescheduled to be played in late January 2021, with 23, 24 or 30 January being the possible dates.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/la-libertadores-y-la-sudamericana-ya-tienen-fecha|title=La Libertadores y la Sudamericana ya tienen fecha|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=10 July 2020|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2020_version_pos_pandemia_06_07_2020_aprobado_consejo.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2020|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es}}</ref> Eventually, on 9 November 2020, CONMEBOL determined that the final would be played on 23 January 2021.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/la-final-unica-se-disputara-el-23-de-enero-en-el-mario-alberto-kempes|title=La Final Única se disputará el 23 de enero en el Mario Alberto Kempes|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=9 November 2020|language=es}}</ref>

Defensa y Justicia defeated Lanús by a 3–0 score to win their first Copa Sudamericana title. This victory also meant the first title in the history of the team.<ref>[https://www.lanacion.com.ar/deportes/futbol/defensa-campeon-copa-sudamericana-secretos-nid2580211 Defensa y Justicia, campeón de la Copa Sudamericana] by Ariel Ruya on ''La Nación'', 23 Jan 2021</ref><ref>[https://www.tycsports.com/liga-profesional-de-futbol/defensa-y-justicia-campeon-copa-sudamericana-2020-id317334.html Aprendan a confiar] on TyC Sports, 24 Jan 2021</ref><ref>[https://www.pagina12.com.ar/319237-defensa-y-justicia-es-el-nuevo-campeon-de-la-copa-sudamerica Defensa y Justicia es el nuevo campeón] by Fabio Lannutti on ''Pagina/12'', 24 Jan 2021</ref> As champions, Defensa y Justicia earned the right to play against the winners of the [[2020 Copa Libertadores]] in the [[2021 Recopa Sudamericana]]. They also automatically qualified for the [[2021 Copa Libertadores]] group stage.<ref name="Post-match">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/defensa-y-justicia-se-codea-con-la-gloria-y-alcanza-la-gran-conquista|title=Defensa y Justicia se codea con la gloria y alcanza La Gran Conquista|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=23 January 2021|language=es}}</ref>

This was the first time both Copa Sudamericana finalists represented the same country. As of 2025, this is the only all-Argentine Copa Sudamericana final and the only time Copa Sudamericana was awarded in a derby (as both clubs represent [[Buenos Aires Province|the province of Buenos Aires]]). 

==Venue==
Since 2019, the Copa Sudamericana final is played as a single match at a venue chosen in advance.<ref>{{cite web |title=Histórica decisión: Final Única de la Libertadores 2019 en Santiago y Final Única de la Sudamericana 2019 en Lima |url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/historica-decision-final-unica-de-la-libertadores-2019-en-santiago-y-final-unica-de-la-sudamericana |publisher=CONMEBOL |language=es |date=14 August 2018}}</ref> CONMEBOL announced on 15 October 2019 that the following four venues were candidates for the 2020 final:<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/conmebol-seleccionara-las-ciudades-anfitrionas-para-las-finales-unicas-de-2020-en-el-consejo-del-17|title=CONMEBOL seleccionará las ciudades anfitrionas para las Finales Únicas de 2020 en el Consejo del 17 de octubre|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=15 October 2019|language=es}}</ref>

On 17 October 2019, CONMEBOL announced that [[Estadio Mario Alberto Kempes]], [[Córdoba, Argentina|Córdoba]] was chosen as the 2020 final venue.<ref name="venue"/>
[[File:Estadio Kempes luego de finalizar un partido.jpg|thumb|300px|[[Estadio Mario Alberto Kempes]] in [[Córdoba, Argentina|Córdoba]], Argentina, hosted the final]]
